exact_missing_items: Governing layer design: deterministic scheduler/state machine (not one long-running super-agent); bounded worker/reviewer/remediation agents with explicit context windows; lightweight planning/replan agent only at graph-construction or graph-patch boundaries

Supersession hotspot docs (highest-risk for canon collapse): Plans/orchestrator-subagent-integration.md, Plans/human-in-the-loop.md, Plans/usage-feature.md, Plans/FinalGUISpec.md, Plans/Contracts_V0.md, Plans/storage-plan.md
orchestrator.receipt.{run_id}.{attempt_id} already carries: repo_id, worktree_id, branch, commit-range, workflow refs — this existing data contract must be formally documented and extended
keep one global Persona precedence chain
require each surface auto resolver to emit a deterministic ranked candidate set plus explanation metadata

Orchestrator auto resolver inputs: actor type (package overseer, seam overseer, node worker, verifier/reviewer, corroborator, graph patch planner, recovery actor), work type/operation type (implementation, review, integration, corroboration, recovery, planning/patching), scope level (seam, package, node, attempt), project hints (language(s), framework(s), repo/domain traits)

Orchestrator work needs careful treatment of task / run / subagent override scopes: package-level overrides must not leak across unrelated runs; subagent overrides must not accidentally become package defaults; historical runs keep their frozen effective Persona state
Scoped override lifecycle: turn, session, run, task, subagent

Orchestrator actor type Persona defaults: package overseer -> execution/governance persona biased toward package-local delivery and readiness truth; seam overseer -> integration/governance persona biased toward cross-package integration truth; node worker -> implementation persona biased by language/framework/work type; verifier/reviewer -> review persona distinct from drafting/implementation persona; corroborator -> review/challenge persona distinct from original claimer; recovery actor -> troubleshooting/recovery persona; graph patch planner -> planning/architecture persona
Chat/Interview/Builder/Orchestrator should still share the same effective resolution record and display grammar
